names.zh: 夕阳阶梯（夕やけだんだん）
names.name_notes: Wikidata Q11430153 zh label is 夕陽階梯 (traditional); 夕阳阶梯 is our simplified rendering, not an official name. OSM name tag spells it 夕焼けだんだん; Arakawa City uses 夕やけだんだん.

checkin.point_description: Top (east end) of the steps, where 御殿坂 meets the stairs; the classic view looks west down the steps to the 谷中ぎんざ gate.

source.what: OSM way 33440592 (highway=steps, name=夕焼けだんだん, wikidata=Q11430153); first node = upper end (incline=down along way direction). Overpass API (https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter) query of OSM data

cross_check.what: Wikidata P625 35.727639,139.767083 (about 23 m from chosen point, roughly at the bottom of the steps)

checkin.radius_reason: Steps are short (OSM way ~31 m; ja.wikipedia says length 15 m) and the Yanaka Ginza check-in centre is only 116 m away (straight line). 40 m keeps the two circles apart. Consumer GPS in narrow streets can err 20-50 m, so field-test this radius.

places.intro_zh: 夕やけだんだん是从日暮里站方向的御殿坂下行至谷中银座商店街的一段缓坡石阶，位于荒川区西日暮里三丁目。站在台阶上方可以俯瞰商店街入口的门形招牌与街道。荒川区官方介绍称其名称经公开征集而定，并以能眺望晚霞闻名。

intro_sources.what: Arakawa City official page: steps leading from 御殿坂 to 谷中銀座; name chosen by public contest (一般公募); sunset view; location 荒川区西日暮里3-13付近
Tokyo Metropolitan Govt accessibility guide: 'Yuyake Dandan is the name of the steps located between Gotenzaka and Yanaka Ginza'

cultural_detail.zh: 1990年日暮里三丁目町会举办“给石阶取名”征集活动，地区杂志《谷根千》的编辑、作家森まゆみ的投稿被采用，这段36级的缓坡台阶由此得名。

source.what: 荒川ゆうネット archive on Arakawa City domain (site operated 2004-2010, content as of publication): 36段のゆるやかな階段; 名付け親は森まゆみ; 1990年 日暮里三丁目町会『石段に名前を付けようコンクール』

corroboration.what: ja.wikipedia (secondary): 1990 renovation, named by 森まゆみ, 36 steps, 4.4 m wide

visual_features: Wide, gently sloping stone/paver steps descending westward, with a central handrail and side railings (OSM: handrail:center=yes)
At the foot of the steps: the gabled gateway arch with the sign 谷中ぎんざ, with the narrow shopping street continuing beyond it
Shopping street lined with shop awnings, banners and lantern-style street lamps, seen from above
Multi-storey apartment block with white balcony railings on the right (north) side when looking down the steps
Dense overhead utility poles and wires framing the view
confusable_places: View of the same 谷中ぎんざ gate from inside Yanaka Ginza looking east (shows the steps from below) - belongs to the Yanaka Ginza node, not this one
Other slopes of the Nippori/Yanaka hill named by Arakawa City: 御殿坂, 七面坂, 富士見坂 (source: Arakawa archive page above)
Other Tokyo shopping-street gateways with similar arches (e.g. the よみせ通り arch sign)
unsuitable_angles: Close-ups of cats, shop goods or people
Night shots where the gate sign is not legible
Shots from the bottom that do not include the steps

change_alerts.what: A 7-storey condominium (ウィルローズ谷中銀座, 荒川区西日暮里3-14) was built right next to the steps; reported completion late May 2026. It is likely on the left (south) side of the classic view and is NOT in any reference photo below (all pre-2026).

sources.what: Toyo Keizai article (via search snippet): 7-storey condo next to 夕焼けだんだん, completion scheduled late May 2026
ja.wikipedia (uncited statement): completed late May 2026, sunset now harder to see

change_alerts.action: Needs a field visit and new post-2026 reference photos before enabling photo verification.

places.intro_zh: 谷中银座商店街位于台东区谷中三丁目与荒川区西日暮里三丁目一带。据商店街振兴组合官网，约60家店铺分布在全长约170米的短街上，以传统个人商店为主。街道东端入口连接夕やけだんだん台阶，西端与よみせ通り相接。

intro_sources.what: Official site of 谷中銀座商店街振興組合: 約60店舗が全長170メートルほどの短い通り; 昭和20年頃に自然発生的に生まれた
ja.wikipedia: 所在地 台東区谷中3丁目及び荒川区西日暮里3丁目
OSM: west end node of 谷中銀座 way is shared with よみせ通り way 33440536

cultural_detail.zh: 商店街官网记载：商店街约于昭和20年（1945年）前后自然形成；平成18年（2006年）统一了遮阳篷并设置了竖向招牌，平成20年（2008年）设置了木雕猫。

source.what: 商店街沿革: 平成18年には日よけの統一や袖看板の設置、20年には木彫り猫の設置

cultural_detail.caveat: Whether the wooden cats are all still in place in 2026 is not verified; do not make them a required story answer without a field check.

visual_features: Narrow pedestrian street paved in reddish-brown with lighter edge strips
Unified shop awnings (many green) and vertical projecting signs (袖看板) along both sides
Lantern-style street lamps on curved posts
Gabled gateway arch with the sign 谷中ぎんざ at the east end, with the steps rising behind it
Wooden cat carvings placed on shop fronts/roofs (installed 2008 per official site; current presence unverified)
confusable_places: よみせ通り (meets the west end; wider, carries vehicles, no unified awnings)
The view from the top of 夕やけだんだん (overlaps visually - that is a separate node)
Other Tokyo 'Ginza'-named shopping streets with similar arches and awnings
unsuitable_angles: Close-ups of goods/food or single shop signs
Shots dominated by people or staff (privacy)
Festival-only decorations (e.g. ひゃっこい祭り banners) as the main identifying feature

places.intro_zh: よみせ通り是与谷中银座西端相接、大致南北走向的生活街道，沿线分布着商店与餐饮店。东京都的无障碍观光指南介绍，这里过去是夜市摊贩云集的街道，名称意为“夜店街”；街道没有人行道，步行时需留意车辆。

places.intro_zh: 冈仓天心纪念公园位于台东区谷中五丁目，是冈仓天心旧居及日本美术院的旧址，台东区于1967年将其作为纪念公园开放。园内六角堂中安放着平栉田中所作的天心坐像，六角堂的门通常关闭。公园于2026年3月完成设施更新工程。

intro_sources.what: Taito City culture guide: 日本美術院の跡を台東区が記念し昭和42年(1967)に開園; 六角堂に平櫛田中作の天心坐像; 通常は六角堂の扉は閉じています
Taito City: 岡倉天心記念公園施設更新工事, park closed 令和7年10月-令和8年3月, completed 令和8年3月27日
Taito Film Commission: 所在地 台東区谷中5-7-10

cultural_detail.zh: 园内有一块“谷中鶯”诗碑，刻有天心即兴所作的诗句，由日本画家横山大观执笔书写，并配有黄莺与红梅的图样。

source.what: 日本美術院跡の谷中鶯の碑: 天心が即興で詠んだ詩の碑が、横山大観の筆により建てられています。歌には、鶯と紅梅の絵が添えられています。

visual_features: Small hexagonal hall (六角堂): vermilion pillars and beams, white plaster walls, black double doors with small glass panes, green copper-coloured roof with a round finial
Low stone platform and steps in front of the hall, hexagon-patterned paving
Tall natural-stone poem stele (谷中鶯の碑) with carved inscription
Square granite pillar inscribed 岡倉天心先生宅跡 日本美術院発祥之地
Entrance with low natural-stone wall and a small stone name post 岡倉天心記念公園
Since 2026-03: bamboo-fence-style screen fence (replacing old concrete wall), new step play equipment and seesaw (per Taito City)
confusable_places: The 六角堂 with Hirakushi Denchu's Tenshin statue on the Tokyo University of the Arts campus (Taito City page mentions it) - different place
The original Rokkakudo at Izura (五浦), Ibaraki, linked to Tenshin
Generic small neighbourhood parks with play equipment (if the hall is not in frame)
unsuitable_angles: Close-ups of the inscription plaque only
Interior of the hall (doors usually closed)

names.name_notes: Registered name 観音寺築地塀 (かんのんじついじべい). Tokyo guide uses 'Kannonji Temple, Roofed Mud Wall'. zh is our rendering.

checkin.point_description: Midpoint of the wall along the public alley on the temple's south side (the wall faces the alley; no need to enter the temple).

source.what: OSM way 821619430 (barrier=wall, name:en=Tsuijibei) midpoint; runs alongside public alley OSM way 45738213. Overpass API (https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter) query of OSM data

cross_check.what: Wikidata P625 for the temple 35.725639,139.768083 (40 m north of the wall, inside temple grounds)
Agency for Cultural Affairs DB: 所在地 台東区谷中5-8-28; wall bounds the south side of the precinct

checkin.radius_reason: Wall is 37.6 m long (official; OSM geometry ~44 m). Several other temples lie within 60 m (加納院, 本立寺, 長安寺, 養傳寺 per OSM), so keep tight; field-test GPS.

places.intro_zh: 观音寺位于台东区谷中五丁目。寺院南侧的筑地塀以瓦片与黏土交替层层叠砌，上覆瓦顶，全长37.6米，设有一处小门。这道墙于2000年登录为国家登录有形文化财，面朝公共小巷，可在路边观看。

intro_sources.what: 国指定文化財等データベース: 観音寺築地塀, 登録有形文化財(建造物), 練塀・瓦葺・延長37.6m, 登録年月日 2000.04.28, 瓦と粘土を交互に積み重ねて造り、潜り戸一所を備える
Spot 2 Kannonji Temple, Roofed Mud Wall: address 5-8-28 Yanaka; 'Traffic is light on the road in front of the wall'

cultural_detail.zh: 据文化厅数据库，观音寺在明和九年（1772年）火灾中烧毁，文政年间前后重建；这道墙建于江戸末期，被认为保留了当年与浅草齐名的江户著名寺町风貌。

source.what: 解説文: 観音寺は明和9年(1772)の火災で灰燼に帰した後、文政年間頃に再興された…浅草と並ぶ江戸有数の寺町であった当時の面影を伝える。時代: 江戸末期 1830-1867

cultural_detail.note: ja.wikipedia says the wall was built in the 文政 era (1818-1831); the official DB dates it 江戸末期 (1830-1867). Use the official wording.

visual_features: Long low wall built of alternating horizontal bands of grey roof tiles and earthen clay
Tiled coping roof along the top with round-ended tiles
Small wooden wicket door (潜り戸) set into the wall
Stone base and stone posts at the east corner, with metal registration/description plaques
Narrow asphalt alley running alongside, tree canopy of the temple behind
confusable_places: Kannon-ji's own main gate (山門) on 初音の道 - same temple, different feature; not the check-in target
Walls/gates of neighbouring temples within ~60 m (加納院, 本立寺, 長安寺, 養傳寺, 海蔵院 - OSM)
Ordinary plastered or concrete block walls in Yanaka's temple district

checkin.point_description: 神橋 (shinkyō bridge) / open plaza in front of the 楼門, inside the shrine grounds but outside the inner 唐門 area.

source.what: OSM way 467555830 (bridge=yes, name=神橋) centre; 楼門 is OSM way 164586227 at 35.719662,139.760941 (23 m away). Overpass API (https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter) query of OSM data

checkin.radius_reason: Large precinct (官网: 七千坪); isolated from the other nodes (≥861 m), so a wider radius is safe.

places.intro_zh: 根津神社位于文京区根津一丁目，神社官网称其为相传由日本武尊创祀的古社。现存社殿于宝永三年（1706年）建成，本殿、币殿、拜殿、唐门、西门、透塀与楼门均为国家重要文化财。境内以约3000株杜鹃闻名。

intro_sources.what: Official: 御由緒; 宝永3年(1706)完成…欠けずに現存し、国の重要文化財; つつじ 100種3,000株
Spot 6 Nezu-jinja Shrine: address 1-28-9 Nezu, Bunkyo-ku; free entry to grounds

cultural_detail.zh: 神社官网介绍，楼门是江户市内神社楼门中唯一留存至今的一座；门内安放的随身像中，面向右侧的一尊据说以水户黄门为原型。

source.what: 境内案内 ③楼門: 江戸内の神社の楼門で唯一残っているもの。安置してある随身の向かって右側は水戸黄門だと言われています。

cultural_detail.note: The Mito Kōmon statement is phrased by the shrine as 'it is said' (と言われています); keep that hedge.

visual_features: Two-storey vermilion tower gate with dark tiled hip-and-gable roof and gold-trimmed eaves
Centre plaque reading 根津神社 under the upper balcony
Seated guardian (随身) figures in the side bays behind green lattice fences
Green-railed arched stone bridge (神橋) and pond edge in front
Tall cedar/evergreen trees flanking the gate
confusable_places: 唐門 (inner gate, also vermilion, also Important Cultural Property)
Other vermilion shrine gates in Tokyo
千本鳥居 path to 乙女稲荷 (resembles Fushimi Inari)

places.photo_restrictions: 神社官网明确：个人参拜及观光纪念拍摄无需申请；禁止在社殿前参道（石板路）上拍摄、禁止社殿内拍摄、禁止“不参拜只拍照”、禁止长时间或多人占地拍摄、禁止大型器材、禁止无许可拍摄神职/巫女/其他参拜者；千本鸟居应从反面拍摄或在发布时模糊处理；禁止作为写真素材分发/销售；商业网站刊载用拍摄需申请。

story_nodes.suggested_start: JR/Keisei Nippori Station west exit, then up 御殿坂 to the top of the steps (start coordinates not researched here)
story_nodes.route_logic: From the top of the steps, go back east along 御殿坂 and south along 初音の道 (OSM way 233714978) to Kannon-ji's south alley; then west to the park; then north into Yanaka Ginza; exit west onto よみせ通り toward Sendagi Station; Nezu is a separate extension to the south-west.
story_nodes.distance_disclaimer: All distances are straight-line (haversine, WGS84) between the check-in coordinates above, NOT walking distances. Actual walking paths are longer (e.g. the step-1 to step-2 leg requires going around via 御殿坂/初音の道). Walking routes were not measured or field-checked.

notes.method: Desk research only: OSM via Overpass API & Nominatim, Wikidata API, official municipal/shrine/商店街 websites, Agency for Cultural Affairs DB, Wikimedia Commons API. Reference photo thumbnails were viewed in a scratch directory to write view notes; nothing was downloaded into the repo.
notes.not_field_verified: No coordinate, radius, feature, hour or route has been checked on site.
gaps: Taito City official tourism site t-navi.city.taito.lg.jp (spot/1105, spot/1076, cited in spec 12.1) was unreachable on 2026-10-23: TLS certificate mismatch, and with verification bypassed it returns a notice that the site is suspended indefinitely due to a PHP vulnerability. Replaced with Taito City culture pages, city park works page, Film Commission page and the national cultural property DB.
GO TOKYO Yanaka & Nezu page (cited in spec 12.1) returned HTTP 502 on 2026-10-23; not used.
よみせ通り: only 2 usable licensed photos (2009, 2018) -> location-only.
観音寺の築地塀: only 3 licensed photos, two nearly the same angle; no west-end view.
夕やけだんだん: all 5 photos pre-date the 7-storey condominium completed next to the steps (reported May 2026); the scene has likely changed.
岡倉天心記念公園: all photos pre-date the Oct 2025 - Mar 2026 renovation (fence, play equipment changed).
谷中銀座: newest street-level photo is 2019; shop fronts change frequently.
Opening hours / photo rules not found for 夕やけだんだん, 岡倉天心記念公園, よみせ通り, and personal photography at 谷中銀座.
Exact position and current state of the よみせ通り arch sign unverified.
Presence of 谷中銀座 wooden cat carvings in 2026 unverified.
Chinese names are the researcher's renderings except where noted (Wikidata zh labels for 夕陽階梯 and 根津神社).
accuracy_doubts: OSM geometry lengths differ from official figures (Kannon-ji wall: OSM ~44 m vs official 37.6 m; steps: OSM ~31 m vs ja.wikipedia 15 m; Yanaka Ginza: OSM ~194 m vs official ~170 m). Coordinates are probably good to ~10-20 m but not surveyed.
Small radii (35-40 m) may be unreliable with phone GPS in narrow streets; field calibration needed.
Some facts rest on secondary sources: the 2026 condominium completion date (Toyo Keizai via search snippet; ja.wikipedia uncited); ja.wikipedia used only for corroboration.
The Arakawa archive page for the naming of 夕やけだんだん is an archived city sub-site (2004-2010) - official but old.
Several Commons descriptions are imprecise (Higa4's Nezu photos say 台東区谷中; Nezu is in 文京区). Images themselves were visually checked.
Nezu Shrine's hours were read from an image on the official site, transcribed manually.
licence_notes: All proposed photos are real photographs on Wikimedia Commons under CC0, PD-self, CC BY 2.0/3.0/4.0 or CC BY-SA 3.0/4.0 (Flickr imports checked: FlickreviewR passed for the two checked). No AI-generated images.

CC BY / BY-SA require attribution (author, licence, link) wherever the image is shown; BY-SA additionally requires derivatives (e.g. crops distributed to users) to be shared under the same licence. Prefer CC0/PD images where an image might be displayed or transformed.
Commons 'Restrictions' metadata was empty for all selected files, but many street photos include identifiable people; prefer using them only as internal AI reference, not public display.

Nezu Shrine forbids distributing/selling photos of its grounds as stock material; using third-party Commons photos as internal verification reference is a different use, but confirm with the shrine before any public display.
This is not legal advice; have the licence handling reviewed.
